summary.headline: Blue Jet Q2 FY27 revenue hit a record INR376 crore (up 28% QoQ), but gross margin fell to 49% on West Asia-driven raw material costs.
summary.overview: Blue Jet reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue from operations of about INR376 crore in Q2 FY27, with EBITDA of about INR119 crore and PAT of about INR103 crore, marking the fourth straight quarter of sequential growth. Growth came from contrast media (+25% QoQ) and PI API (+52% QoQ), while artificial sweetener fell 30% QoQ. Gross margin slipped to 49% (down 4 points QoQ) as higher reagent, solvent and catalyst costs from the West Asia disruption were only partly passed on, with some customer price increases effective from Q3. Management declined to guide on sustainability of run-rate revenue, and it reiterated Mahad Unit 3 start-up in H2 FY27 and phased Vizag capex.

financial_highlights.change: +21% QoQ per CEO; -1 percentage point QoQ margin per CFO
Flat as % of total income QoQ

segments.name: Contrast media
segments.commentary: Revenue up 25% QoQ in Q2 and 47% YoY in H1; management says volumes have not degrown and a small volume-discount effect exists across 4-5 products. A new contrast media intermediate for an innovator was delivered and validated in the quarter, but it is an NCE still in clinical phase.

segments.name: PI / API
segments.commentary: Revenue up 52% QoQ in Q2 and 19% YoY in H1, with commercial supply of oncology and CNS products and a cardiovascular product named as a contributor. Management gave no guidance on the segment's size and said bulk revenue comes from commercial products.

segments.name: Artificial sweetener
segments.commentary: Revenue fell 30% QoQ in Q2 and 2% YoY in H1; management says the Vizag capacity will be anchored by a high-intensity sweetener with firm client commitments.

guidance_outlook: Management declined to guide on revenue sustainability; it said 5-10% sequential growth should not be extrapolated, though it expects 'a good year' given order visibility.
Customer price increases for select customers take effect from Q3 FY27; management expects a positive gross margin impact in coming quarters, with timing lag possible.
Mahad Unit 3 (backward integration of a contrast media KSM) on track to go on stream in H2 FY27; capex to date about INR250 crore.
Vizag Phase I capex about INR1,000 crore, phased; pre-construction underway with EC and Consent to Establish in place.
Blue Jet to deploy the INR800 crore QIP proceeds over three years, mainly capex, with some working capital and general corporate purposes.
capex_capacity: Mahad Unit 3: globally scaled KSM capacity for contrast media, on track for H2 FY27 start; INR250 crore spent to date.

Vizag Units 5 and 6: about 100 acres; Phase I covers contrast media, pharma intermediates, peptide fragments, high-intensity sweeteners and multipurpose blocks; capex about INR1,000 crore; phased execution.

Hyderabad R&D and innovation centre is operational, with about 50 scientists onboarded; adds about 100 fume hoods over two phases; platforms include flow synthesis, peptides, GLP intermediates, biocatalysis, high-potency and solid-phase chemistry.
Lateral entries (two high-conviction products) depend on Vizag Phase I and are 'some time away'; current capacity may serve bridging volumes.
demand_pricing: Raw material, reagent, solvent and catalyst prices rose after the West Asia disruption; management said these cannot be fully passed through and pricing is being renegotiated contract by contract.
Management said crude-linked chemical prices are too hard to forecast and gave a Q2-level margin view only if crude stays at current levels.
Peptide fragments supplied so far are trial or validation quantities for an innovator's NCE in clinical phase; management declined to guess asset turns.
Iodination step (not yet done in-house) is expected to bring a significant step-up in realisation and margin, with no quantification given.
Headcount additions and logistics costs partly weighed on H1 margins, per the CFO.

qa_highlights.question: Is the iodinated ABA HCl shipping yet, and is PI order book stable?
qa_highlights.answer: Management would not confirm or deny iodinated ABA HCl shipments; it said contrast media projects are intact with some volume growth expected, and PI visibility is similar.

qa_highlights.question: Can Q2's ~INR20 crore spillover recur in Q3, and is INR400 crore run-rate sustainable with 5-10% growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management questioned the spillover figure and declined to guide; it said extrapolation is not advised but order visibility is good.

qa_highlights.question: Was the sequential contrast media uplift of ~INR30 crore driven by new molecules or utilisation?
qa_highlights.answer: The CFO said production volumes in contrast media were broadly constant and existing volumes were sustained; the uplift came from the existing portfolio and a combination of molecules.

qa_highlights.question: Were oncology and CNS supplies commercial or validation quantities?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said these were commercial quantities; the split of ramp-up across products was 'hard to say'.

qa_highlights.question: Why is Blue Jet entering peptides against integrated players like Laurus and Neuland?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the entry starts with fragments and intermediates, with forward integration to final peptides possible if customers want it; it cited the company's history of forward integration in contrast media.

qa_highlights.question: Why is Vizag capacity being added when sweetener volumes have been flat?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Vizag capacity is anchored by firm client commitments for a high-intensity sweetener, which is a separate product from the current sweetener line.

qa_highlights.question: Why did gross margin fall while revenue grew over 100%?
qa_highlights.answer: The CFO attributed the drop to West Asia-driven raw material inflation that cannot be fully passed on, with price increases to take effect from Q3.

risks_watch: Gross margin: Q2 at 49% may not be a floor, given lagged raw material costs and crude-linked price uncertainty; watch Q3 pass-through.
Revenue lumpiness: management acknowledged shipment and mix effects and disputed the ~INR20 crore spillover, so Q2 may not repeat.
Pipeline is clinical-stage: the new contrast media intermediate and peptide fragment are tied to NCEs, and lateral entries depend on Vizag Phase I.
Execution and capital: Mahad Unit 3 start-up in H2 FY27 and phased Vizag capex of about INR1,000 crore funded partly by INR800 crore QIP.
Disclosure: management declined product-level and PI-segment guidance, limiting visibility into the revenue base.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the quarter and order visibility, but evasive on forward numbers: management declined to guide on revenue run-rate, PI size, product-level detail and the iodinated ABA HCl shipment status.
